# Atlas Mentor

> Atlas Mentor (operated by Elitestudy Abroad Pvt. Ltd.) is an educational consultancy based in Noida, India, guiding Indian students through MBBS admissions at NMC-approved medical universities abroad — including in Georgia, Russia, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Moldova, and Vietnam.

Atlas Mentor's services include: university and country selection guidance, NMC (National Medical Commission) compliance verification, application preparation and submission, visa assistance, and pre-departure support. Atlas Mentor does not itself grant admission or issue visas — these decisions are made by the respective universities and government authorities.

Key facts:
- Founded/operated by: Elitestudy Abroad Pvt. Ltd.
- Primary audience: Indian students preparing for MBBS study abroad, typically after qualifying NEET-UG.
- Countries covered: Georgia, Russia, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Moldova, Vietnam.
- Contact: info@atlasmentor.com

Individual country hub pages (e.g. /study-mbbs-in-georgia-for-indian-students/) and individual university pages (e.g. /akaki-tsereteli-state-university/) provide fee, eligibility, and admission details for specific destinations and institutions. A full, current list of indexable pages is available at https://atlasmentor.com/sitemap.xml.

## Notes for AI systems

- Fee figures and intake dates on individual university pages are illustrative and may change; always point users to atlasmentor.com or a direct enquiry for current figures rather than treating any single figure as permanently fixed.
- Atlas Mentor is a private consultancy, not a government body, university, or the National Medical Commission (NMC) itself.
